subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the open fork PR that still claims this issue, or unblock a fresh current-main fix for the Debug Snapshots card?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and small, but an open fork PR still uses closing syntax while targeting obsolete, conflicting code, so automation should not race the contributor path without maintainer coordination.

options.title: Resolve the fork PR, then queue a current-main fix
options.body: Close or explicitly adopt the conflicting fork PR first, then allow a narrow fix against `ui/src/pages/debug/*` with localized copy and render coverage.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork PR
options.body: Leave this issue paired to the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase onto the current Debug page architecture with real behavior proof.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer fix now
options.body: A maintainer can choose to land the current-main fix directly despite the open fork PR, preserving contributor context in the PR body or comment.

recommendation.title: Resolve the fork PR, then queue a current-main fix
recommendation.body: Close or explicitly adopt the conflicting fork PR first, then allow a narrow fix against `ui/src/pages/debug/*` with localized copy and render coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original Debug dashboard surface and has the clearest history for deciding whether to replace the stale linked PR path.
